name: Ibiza Airport

hours.v: open 24 hours in summer and until 31 October; from 1 November open 0630-2300, with extension on 1 hour prior permission
hours.quote: V: H24. I: Until October 31st: H24. From November 1st: 0630-2300. PS 1 HR PPR.

runway.v: one runway, 06/24, 2,799 m long and 45 m wide

customs.v: customs and immigration during aerodrome hours

slots.v: an airport slot is needed except for flights in VFR conditions
slots.quote: Flights in VFR conditions are exempt from the previous request for airport slot.

ppr.v: from 1 May to 15 October, general aviation aircraft over 18 m wingspan (and helicopters staying over 3 hours) need prior parking authorisation before requesting a slot
ppr.quote: In this case, requesting the airport slot requires prior parking authorisation from the Airport.

max_aircraft.v: aircraft of up to 18 m wingspan may park on the commercial apron for at most one week
max_aircraft.quote: the maximum parking time of an aircraft with a maximum wingspan of 18 m in the Commercial Aviation Apron is one week.

handling.v: the AIP lists two General and Business Aviation managers (FBO): Aviapartner Ibiza FBO and Sky Valet Spain
handling.quote: General and Business Aviation Managers (FBO) (in alphabetical order):

noise.v: reverse thrust above idle is not allowed from 2200 to 0500 except for safety
noise.quote: Reverse thrust other than idling may not be used except for safety reasons from 2200 to 0500.

notes: V/I in the AIP mean summer/winter season. The page does not state whether 0630-2300 and 2200-0500 are UTC or local; the Spanish AIP normally gives times in UTC unless marked LT (if UTC, the winter hours are 07:30-00:00 local) - not converted here. The winter closure outside aerodrome hours is not a noise curfew. Customs 'HR AD' means same hours as the aerodrome, so H24 in summer. Page header shows WEF 09-JUL-26 and WEF 11-JUN-26.
